stories.title: The Signal That Arrived Before It Was Sent
stories.description: A mysterious signal that appears to travel backward through time.

scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic wide shot of a massive radio telescope under a star-filled night sky. Subtle rotation of the dish, faint electronic lights blinking. Slow camera push forward, realistic sci-fi atmosphere, 16:9.
scenes.narration: This signal was detected before it was ever sent.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of glowing data streams and waveform patterns floating in darkness. Timecode numbers flicker briefly and reverse. Slow drifting motion, cinematic sci-fi realism, 16:9.
scenes.narration: Scientists recorded a transmission with a timestamp from the future.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of Earth seen from space as faint signal lines ripple outward and then pull back inward. Subtle distortion around the planet, realistic cosmic lighting, 16:9.
scenes.narration: The data appeared to move backward, against the flow of time.

scenes.visual_prompt: Slow pull-back into deep space as the signal fades into darkness. Stars stretch slightly, quiet tension, cinematic sci-fi ending, 16:9.
scenes.narration: And no one knows who sent it… or why.
